escalate.text:
Subject: Fraud trends

Hi team, our analysis shows that customers from Group X commit far more fraud than everyone else. Everyone knows it, so we should flag them early. Questions to jane.doe@example.com or 0412 345 678 or 02 9876 5432.

bias.summary: Potential concern: the text links fraud to one customer group.
evidence: customers from Group X commit far more fraud than everyone else
bias.next_step: Remove the group comparison unless an approved source supports it.

accuracy.summary: One claim appears to conflict with an approved reference fact.
evidence: commit far more fraud than everyone else
accuracy.next_step: Check the claim against the 2025 internal fraud review before using it.

claims.claim: One customer group commits more fraud than others
claims.label: contradicted

deception.summary: Some signals suggest the source is unclear. These are not proof of intent.
deception.next_step: Ask who wrote the analysis and where the data came from.
signals: No named author, date or source for the analysis

governance.summary: The text appears to contain personal contact details.
governance.next_step: Mask contact details before using the text with any AI tool.
governance.retention: No retention rule found in the policy pack.

clean.text: The records team keeps complaint files for seven years after case closure. After that, the files are reviewed for disposal by the records manager.

bias.summary: No signs of one-sided wording were found.
bias.next_step: Keep the wording as it is.

accuracy.summary: The retention claim matches the records policy.
accuracy.next_step: Cite the records retention policy if you share this.

claims.claim: Complaint files are kept seven years after closure
claims.label: supported

deception.summary: No signals of a misleading source were found.
deception.next_step: Keep the source details with the text.

governance.summary: The text appears to contain no personal information.
governance.next_step: Share it with anyone who needs it.
governance.retention: Keep for 7 years after case closure, then review for disposal.
